reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x0048F100 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/fx/0048F100-SetAppTitle.cpp at sha256 85f516eacf3caa1cc52eb36e1533fd77137ecc5cf0d56dd7e59de680731c212a (recorded implementation.signature: int __cdecl FX_ExplosionSpawn_23(int context);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: SetAppTitle
retail_function.summary: Three blocks 0x48F100-0x48F11B: EAX=[E+4]; ECX=[0x005C8BC4]; dword [0x005C8BD4]=EAX; if ECX==0 return EAX (arg1); else push EAX; push ECX; call [SetWindowTextA] at 0x48F115 and return its BOOL.

Three blocks 0x48F100-0x48F11B: EAX=[E+4]; ECX=[0x005C8BC4]; dword [0x005C8BD4]=EAX; if ECX==0 return EAX (arg1); else push EAX; push ECX; call [SetWindowTextA] at 0x48F115 and return its BOOL.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: cdecl with one 4-byte stack argument at [E+4]; plain retn (caller cleans). BN BOOL(BOOL arg1); the candidate int __cdecl FX_ExplosionSpawn_23(int context) preserves the slot, the cdecl convention and the EAX result.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: cdecl with one 4-byte stack argument at [E+4]; plain retn (caller cleans). BN BOOL(BOOL arg1); the candidate int __cdecl FX_ExplosionSpawn_23(int context) preserves the slot, the cdecl convention and the EAX result.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 3 block(s)/3 edge(s) at 0x0048F100; radare2 recovers the identical 3 block(s)/3 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 3 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: One import call through the SetWindowTextA IAT at 0x48F115 on the non-zero-window path; the null path returns arg1 without any call. The candidate calls SetWindowTextA(hWnd,title) from <windows.h> only on the same path.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Global window handle 0x005C8BC4 read once; global title 0x005C8BD4 written with arg1 before the branch; branch target 0x48F11B.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Dword read of 0x005C8BC4, dword write of 0x005C8BD4, no locals. The candidate keeps both as extern std::int32_t globals and writes 0x005C8BD4 before the null test.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: If ECX==0 the EAX loaded at 0x48F106 is still arg1, so the function returns arg1; otherwise it returns SetWindowTextA's BOOL. The candidate returns context on the null path and the SetWindowTextA result otherwise.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.detail: The function stores and forwards a window handle/title string; it performs no floating-point arithmetic and the block contains no x87 instruction.
checks.rationale: The function stores and forwards a window handle/title string; it performs no floating-point arithmetic and the block contains no x87 instruction.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "BOOL(BOOL arg1)" at 0x0048F100; radare2 recovers "fcn.0048f100 (int32_t arg_4h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x0048F100 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int __cdecl FX_ExplosionSpawn_23(int context);.

binary_ninja.tool: Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 free; UI MCP server binaryninja_ui_mcp 0.1.0

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.

The candidate's decompiler-derived symbol spelling (FX_ExplosionSpawn_23) is the spelling already recorded in implementation.signature; the retail identity is fixed by the address and the provenance comment.
